result.topic_en: Trigonometric identity for a combination of cosines and an estimate of the function $y=1/((1-x)^2x^2)$ on intervals $(n-1)/\mu<x<n/\mu$, with a sketch of its graph and a case split over n.
result.transcription:
$u+v=u'+v'$ ; $u-u'=v'-v=2\delta$
$\cos u+\cos v-\cos u'-\cos v' = 2\sin\frac{u+u'}{2}\sin\frac{u'-u}{2} - 2\sin\frac{v+v'}{2}\sin\frac{v-v'}{2}$
$= 2\sin\delta\left\{\sin\frac{u+u'}{2}-\sin\frac{v+v'}{2}\right\} = 4\sin\delta\sin\frac{u+u'-v-v'}{4}\cos\frac{u+u'+v+v'}{4}$
$\frac{1}{\sqrt{y}}=x(x-1)$
$x-x^2$
[-$\delta$-] $2x-1$
$u=x+\alpha+\beta$
$v=x-\alpha-\beta$
$u'=x+\alpha-\beta$
$v'=x-\alpha+\beta$
$\cos u+\cos v-\cos u'-\cos v' = 4\sin\beta\sin\alpha\cos x$
$-\infty$ bis $-\frac{1}{\mu}$
[Figur: Gerade mit Halbkreisen um 0 und 1]
[Figur: Kurve $y=\frac{1}{(1-x)^2x^2}$ mit Marken $\frac{n-1}{\mu}$, $\frac{n}{\mu}$, $\frac{c'-1}{\mu}$, $0$, $\frac{1}{2}$, $4$, $1$]
$\frac{1}{\sqrt{y}}=x(x-1)$, für $-\infty<x<0$ und $1<x<\infty$
$=x(1-x)$, für $0<x<1$
$\frac{n-1}{\mu}<x<\frac{n}{\mu}$ ; $y$ ersetzt durch $\frac{1}{(1-\frac{n-1}{\mu})^2(\frac{n-1}{\mu})^2}$ wenn $n$ negativ
durch $\frac{1}{(1-\frac{n}{\mu})^2(\frac{n}{\mu})^2}$ " $0<\frac{n}{\mu}<\frac{1}{2}$
durch $\frac{1}{(1-\frac{n-1}{\mu})^2(\frac{n-1}{\mu})^2}$ " $\frac{1}{2}<\frac{n}{\mu}<1$
" $\frac{1}{(1-\frac{n}{\mu})^2(\frac{n}{\mu})^2}$ " $1<\frac{n}{\mu}$
Intervall [?] $n\leqq-1$ ; $+1\leqq n\leqq\mu-1$ ; $\mu+1\leqq n$
$\frac{1}{x^2}+\frac{1}{(1-x)^2}+\frac{2}{x}+\frac{2}{1-x} = \frac{(1-x)^2+x^2+2x(1-x)^2+2(1-x)x^2}{x^2(1-x)^2}$
[-$=1-2x+x^2+x^2+2x-4x^2+2x^3+2x^2-2x^3$-]
